name: yara
description: Pattern matching engine for malware identification and classification in security research

yara32.description: Scan files and processes using YARA rules to identify malware and suspicious patterns
yara32.usage:
yara32 rules.yar suspicious_file.exe
yara32 -r rules.yar /path/to/scan
yara32 -p 1234 rules.yar
yara32 -s rules.yar file.exe
yara32 -g rules.yar file.exe

yarac32.description: Compile YARA rules into binary format for faster scanning and distribution
yarac32.usage:
yarac32 rules.yar rules.yarc
yarac32 -d symbol=value rules.yar
yarac32 -n namespace rules.yar
yarac32 -w rules.yar
